title: Two Gaussians, Too Many: A bootstrap-based approach to assess identifiability in non-Gaussian structural vector autoregressions
abstract: arXiv:2607.17275v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Normality pre-tests on reduced-form innovations cannot detect whether two or more underlying structural shocks are Gaussian, and hence cannot detect a failure of identification in non-Gaussian SVARs. We propose a bootstrap-based approach that reveals such a failure. Under the null of valid identification and certain regularity conditions, the conditional bootstrap distribution of the maximum likelihood estimator of the impact matrix is asymptotically normal, so the diagnostic reduces to a normality test on the bootstrap replications. The impact-matrix estimator remains consistent and asymptotically normal when one shock is Gaussian and its shape parameter lies on the boundary of the parameter space, so the diagnostic is valid across the entire null hypothesis. When the number of bootstrap replications and the sample size diverge jointly at an appropriate rate, the test statistic, conditional on the data, is asymptotically pivotal. Th

translated_title: 两个高斯就太多了：一种基于自助法评估非高斯结构向量自回归可识别性的方法
translated_abstract: 对简化式冲击项的正态性预检验无法检测两个或更多潜在结构冲击是否为高斯分布，因此无法检测非高斯SVAR中识别失效的问题。我们提出一种基于自助法的方法来揭示这种失效。在有效识别的原假设及一定正则条件下，影响矩阵极大似然估计量的条件自助分布渐近服从正态分布，因此该诊断方法可简化为对自助复制样本的正态性检验。当一个冲击为高斯分布且其形状参数位于参数空间边界上时，影响矩阵估计量仍保持一致性与渐近正态性，因此该诊断在整个原假设范围内均有效。当自助复制次数与样本量以适当速率联合趋于无穷时，检验统计量在给定数据条件下是渐近枢轴的。
tldr: 提出一种基于自助法的诊断方法，通过对影响矩阵极大似然估计量的自助复制样本进行正态性检验，来检测非高斯SVAR中因两个及以上高斯结构冲击导致的识别失效。
en_tdlr: We propose a bootstrap-based diagnostic that tests the normality of bootstrap replications of the maximum likelihood impact-matrix estimator to detect identification failure in non-Gaussian SVARs caused by two or more Gaussian structural shocks.
